stem.text: The Planck constant $h$ has SI units $\text{J s}$.
Which equation could be used to calculate the Planck constant?

A.text: $h = \dfrac{DE}{v}$ where $D$ is distance, $E$ is energy and $v$ is velocity

B.text: $h = \dfrac{v}{D}$ where $v$ is velocity and $D$ is distance

C.text: $h = \dfrac{1}{4\pi E}$ where $E$ is electric field strength

D.text: $h = \dfrac{Fr^{2}}{m}$ where $F$ is force, $r$ is radius and $m$ is mass
